description: This is a test module for a Tic-Tac-Toe game backend API, containing test functions that verify game start, move making, game status, and game history persistence.

methods.name: assert_board_shape(board)
methods.description: Helper function that checks whether the provided board is a list of length 9 with all values being either None, 'X', or 'O'.

methods.name: test_start_game_returns_initial_state(test_app)
methods.description: Tests that starting a new game returns the correct initial game state including a game ID, a valid board shape, current player, and in-progress status.

methods.name: test_make_move_updates_board_and_turn(test_app)
methods.description: Tests that making moves updates the board correctly and switches the current player.

methods.name: test_invalid_move_cell_occupied_returns_400(test_app)
methods.description: Tests that attempting to move to an occupied cell returns a 400 error with an appropriate message.

methods.name: test_invalid_move_game_over_returns_400(test_app)
methods.description: Tests that further moves after game completion are rejected with a 400 error.

methods.name: test_get_game_state_with_moves_and_status(test_app)
methods.description: Tests that fetching game state after a few moves reflects the correct status and current player.

methods.name: test_detect_win_and_persisted_history(test_app)
methods.description: Verifies that a winning game is detected correctly, and the game is recorded in history with status 'won' and winner specified.

methods.name: test_detect_draw_and_persisted(test_app)
methods.description: Verifies that a game resulting in a draw is detected correctly, and the game is recorded in history with status 'draw' and no winner.
